name: primitives-effects-shine
title: Shine
description: A pricing card and two buttons get a soft diagonal streak of white that slides from one edge to the other, either on a loop or in response to hover and taps.
use: A premium or featured card should catch the eye with a subtle recurring light sweep.
avoid: The always-on loop runs forever and pulls attention away from other content on the page.
a11y: The looping sweep never checks prefers-reduced-motion, and tap mode listens to pointer down, so keyboard activation never shines. (keyboard: n-a, labels: n-a, reduced motion: not handled)
looks: On black, a wide rounded pricing card with PRO PLAN, a large $24/mo and a Most popular pill sits above two smaller rounded buttons, Hover me and Click me. A pale diagonal gradient band crosses whichever surface is shining.
behaves: The band travels from the left edge to the right edge in about a second, growing out of one side and fading off the other. The top card repeats it on a delay; the buttons run it once on hover or while held.
customise: Wrap children, or one child with asChild, and set colour, opacity, duration, delay, angle, looping and hover or tap triggering; the gradient and easing are fixed.
weight: light: One gradient overlay translated across the child; no canvas or per-frame loop.
